source_locator: Results section c and preceding visit-frequency results; Methods section g

reproductive_response: fruit set significantly decreased with RBLP (thus increased toward lower-RBLP conditions) and increased with mean pollinator proboscis length
visit_frequency_response: authors interpret the low-RBLP response as potentially related to longer-tongued visitors on oceanic islands
claim_boundary: This counterdirectional response rules out a one-direction reproductive syndrome across plants; mating system is unresolved and Oshima reproductive data are absent.
